title: Quick Charred Greek Beans Gigantes Plaki
description: Charred and fluffy Greek beans dish featuring green chilli and a unique tempering chocolate touch, perfect for kids and adults alike, served on a cedar plank.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Soak the gigantes beans in water for at least 8 hours, then drain and set aside.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and sliced green chilli to the pan and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the tomato paste to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the soaked gigantes beans, salt, and black pepper to the pan, stirring to combine.
Transfer the bean mixture to the soaked cedar plank, spreading it out in an even layer.
Place the cedar plank in the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until the beans are tender and lightly charred.
Remove the plank from the oven and sprinkle the tempering chocolate over the top of the beans.
Return the plank to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes, or until the chocolate is melted and bubbly.
